localScope.jmdict: All fifteen per-character dictionary XML files, containing the 65 complete selected query-family entries, read in full. Restrictions, sense-local flags and alternate readings retained in the XML.
localScope.supportArticles: All fifteen declaring word articles named in selection.json read in full.
localScope.kanjidic2: Selected records inspected for grade, stroke counts, radical records, on/kun, English meanings and nanori. Frozen metadata remains authoritative; nanori are not lexical quiz readings.
localScope.kanjivg: All fifteen pinned canonical SVGs matched the frozen source-index Git blob SHA-1 and byte count. Their component trees and stroke counts were read; 廊 has twelve canonical paths. This is not a fresh visual geometry review.
localScope.joyo: All fifteen extracted rows read. Extraction boundaries were corrected to exclude a page footer and the following bracket-variant heading. This uses the existing PDF text cache, not fresh visual inspection of PDF glyphs.
localScope.comparisons: The initial 113 complete actual comparison cards enumerated in design.json were read on the clean baseline. 土, 日, 目 and 田 were subsequently read in full during authoring, making 117 comparison cards. Missing 株 was not counted or used. 盆 was read separately as a format reference.
localScope.notEstablished: Independent review, native/device execution, exhaustive semantic fallback review and historical etymology remain unestablished.

webScope: Digital Daijisen character headings below were inspected directly through Weblio. Separate Daijisen noun headings were also inspected where stated. Later dictionaries, aggregated examples and unrelated page material are not used as authority. These are original summaries, not copied dictionary articles.

娯.characterEvidence: Enjoyment/pleasure; on ゴ, with supplemental kun たのしむ and たのしみ in Daijisen. Do not silently add those to the frozen KANJIDIC2 reading list or selected quiz list.
娯.lexicalEvidence: 娯楽 (1269290), 娯楽番組 (1269310), 娯楽施設 (1934770). Amusement/entertainment/recreation. The existing 娯楽 article selects practical noun use; dictionary suru coverage is not permission for unrestricted productive suru examples.

寮.characterEvidence: Accommodation/dormitory, historical official/bureau associations and tea-room use. The separate noun entry also covers a villa and temple accommodation or a place where resident monks study. Supplemental つかさ and historical レウ are not selected metadata readings.
寮.lexicalEvidence: 1554230 supplies modern accommodation and archaic bureau, tea-room and villa senses. In the separate つかさ spelling family (2251080), the religious-officiant sense is restricted to 司, not 寮. Do not transfer that restricted sense.

廊.characterEvidence: Connecting corridor or roofed passage; the noun includes a passage between buildings. Not every English large-room hall is 廊.
廊.lexicalEvidence: 廊 (2587370), 廊下 (1560670), 回廊/廻廊 (1199860), 画廊 (1197640). 廊下 is not downstairs or a location below a corridor.
廊.metadataCaution: KANJIDIC2 lists 12 and 11 strokes. Preserve the alternate source count in evidence; verify the canonical SVG separately before choosing the generated count.

栓.characterEvidence: An object plugging an opening and a pipe-opening/closing device, including a tap or stopcock.
栓.lexicalEvidence: 栓 (1956550), 栓抜き (1390770), 水栓 (1886500), 消火栓 (1350180). Earplug みみせん (1317270) must not be conflated with archaic じせん ear-jewelry (2567290).

汽.characterEvidence: Steam/vapor, キ; grade 2. Later aggregated reading lists are not used to replace frozen metadata.
汽.lexicalEvidence: 汽車 (1222700) has steam-train, dated long-distance train and regional non-electric/diesel-train uses. 汽船 (1222730), 汽笛 (1222740). 汽水 (1222720) means brackish water; do not mechanically decompose it as steam water.

症.characterEvidence: The nature/state of an illness and a disease or condition characterized by particular symptoms. Medical context matters; not every English condition is covered.
症.lexicalEvidence: 症 suffix (1351000), 症状 (1351030), 症候群 (1351020), 重症 (1336310), 花粉症 (1194900). Symptoms do not by themselves establish a diagnosis.

砲.characterEvidence: Gun/cannon/artillery. The separate noun entry also has baseball heavy-hitter and home-run usage; do not pretend its meaning is confined to military contexts.
砲.lexicalEvidence: 砲 (1517560), 鉄砲 (1438010: gun, sumo practice pole, colloquial pufferfish), 大砲 (1415030: also baseball long-ball hitter), 発砲 (1477900), 砲撃 (1517600), 砲台 (1747840). Archaic つつ family (2864475) includes 銃/砲. テツ + ホウ becomes てっぽう by compound sound change, not new basic readings テッ/ポウ.
砲.metadataCaution: Nanori づつ is not a lexical quiz reading.

碁.characterEvidence: Go board game. Daijisen also supplies a non-selected キ reading and historical spelling relationship with 棋. Do not infer that every 棋 compound means Go, or conflate the game with the English movement verb.
碁.lexicalEvidence: 碁/棊/棋 ご (1270870), 囲碁 (1155990), 碁石 (1270880), 碁盤 (1270890). The game noun and its spelling variants are distinct from an unrestricted meaning for every compound.

磁.characterEvidence: Magnetic attraction and porcelain are separate established senses. Do not claim all modern magnets are natural stones or attract all metals.
磁.lexicalEvidence: 磁石 (1317080) supports じしゃく and じせき, magnet and magnetic compass; 磁気 (1316990), 磁力 (1772010), 磁器 (1316980).

穀.characterEvidence: Staple seed crops/grains, including rice and barley/wheat; the noun entry also mentions beans. The classical たなつもの entry includes rice and grains. This does not justify a modern selected quiz reading absent from frozen metadata.
穀.lexicalEvidence: 穀物 (1287280), 穀類 (1287310), 脱穀 (1416460), 米穀 (1508940), 雑穀 (1813890). English corn is the broad grain sense, not maize-only; cereals here are crops/grains, not only processed breakfast food.
穀.metadataCaution: Use classical radical 115, retaining Nelson 79 separately in source evidence. Nanori are not selected readings; Daijisen and KANJIDIC2 name-reading lists need not be identical.

穫.characterEvidence: Reaping/gathering crops, カク. Historical spelling クヮク and name readings do not change selected readings.
穫.lexicalEvidence: 収穫 (1330510) has literal harvest, figurative gains/results and fishing/hunting catch senses. 収穫期 (1330530), 収穫物 (1330560). Compound senses must not automatically become unrestricted single-character glosses; figurative gains are not a blanket license for 収穫する.

糖.characterEvidence: Sugar/sweetening substance and sugars in carbohydrate terminology. Daijisen supplies supplemental あめ, not selected in frozen metadata.
糖.lexicalEvidence: 砂糖 (1291600), 糖 (1449610), 糖尿病 (1449640), 糖分 (1449650), 糖類 (1629110). Sugar is a substance noun, not the adjective sweet. Kanji composition is not evidence of a medical cause.

紺.characterEvidence: Deep/dark blue with a purplish cast; no exact standardized color code is established.
紺.lexicalEvidence: 紺 (1290590: noun/no modifier), 紺色 (1290600), 濃紺 (1469920), 紺青 (1290610). The latter has several blue-pigment/color glosses, not a single invariant modern color code.

雰.characterEvidence: Misty/hazy atmosphere, フン; Daijisen notes interchange with 氛. Later aggregated kun きり is not imported into frozen metadata.
雰.lexicalEvidence: 雰囲気 (1505070): atmosphere/mood/ambience and a person's air; physical Earth-atmosphere sense is obsolete. Standard ふんいき; spoken ふいんき is explicitly irregular and not a selected quiz reading. No exact query match for 雰囲気作り is not proof that the expression is impossible.

魅.characterEvidence: Supernatural spirit/monster and captivating/bewitching attraction. Include or qualify the spirit sense rather than silently presenting attraction as exhaustive.
魅.lexicalEvidence: 魅力 (1528150), 魅了 (1528140: noun and separate transitive-suru sense), 魅惑 (1528170), 魅する (2514470: special-class suru). Appeal is not limited to romance/beauty or physical strength.

limits: No exhaustive dictionary or corpus survey is claimed.
No unseen web section, image, glyph geometry or PDF page is claimed inspected.
No void B113 output was used.
Source evidence does not establish independent review or app/device behavior.
